summary: Michael Jackson plays a "champagne and caviar" concert in New York to herald his first album in six years and celebrate his 30th year as a solo artist.
Michael Jackson releases his first album in six years, Invincible, which attempts to present him as a normal R&B singer but is criticized as tedious and undermined by his strange public image.
Michael Jackson accepted a non-existent Artist of the Millennium award at the MTV Video Music Awards after Britney Spears accidentally offered it to him.
ABC outbid US rivals to pay Granada £3.5m for exclusive US rights to Martin Bashir's interview with Michael Jackson, scheduled to air as a two-hour 20/20 special on February 7.

Charities and organizations that benefited from Michael Jackson's generosity seek to distance themselves from him following child molestation charges, and plans for a Michael Jackson performing arts center in Gary, Indiana appear stalled.
Californian police searched Michael Jackson's Neverland Ranch after authorities issued a search warrant related to a criminal investigation.
An arrest warrant was issued for Michael Jackson on multiple charges of child molestation, accusing him of lewd and lascivious behavior with a child under 14.
Michael Jackson broke his silence on child sex allegations via his website, stating the charges were "predicated on a big lie" and that his innocence would be proven in court.
Michael Jackson launched a website dismissing child molestation charges as "a big lie" and said he would try his case in court, not in the media.

Michael Jackson's attorney Mark Geragos holds a press conference promising a vigorous defense against child molestation charges and warning that anyone who besmirches Jackson's reputation will be dealt with harshly.

Prosecutors investigating child abuse allegations against Michael Jackson have encountered embarrassing setbacks, including the district attorney's apology for calling Jackson "Wacko Jacko," while Jackson's camp has scored public relations victories and no charges have been filed yet.
Michael Jackson was charged with seven counts of child molestation and two counts of intoxicating the victim in a California court.

Michael Jackson gave an exclusive television interview in which he accused police of manhandling him during his arrest and denied child molestation charges, amid reports CBS paid him an additional $1 million for the interview.
Michael Jackson pleaded not guilty to child sex abuse charges after arriving late to his California court hearing.
Los Angeles police announced they are investigating a new allegation of child abuse against Michael Jackson by a person claiming to have been a victim in the late 1980s.
A Californian grand jury decides there is enough evidence for Michael Jackson to stand trial on child sex abuse charges, which he has denied.
Michael Jackson appeared in a California court for a pre-trial hearing in his child molestation case, where prosecutor Tom Sneddon testified.
Graphic details emerged from grand jury testimony in which a 15-year-old boy accused Michael Jackson of molestation and plying him with alcohol at Neverland.
Michael Jackson released a video statement denying child molestation charges and condemning leaks of court transcripts on the eve of his trial.
Michael Jackson's lawyers said they may call his two children and celebrities including Elizabeth Taylor, Diana Ross, Kobe Bryant, and Larry King as witnesses in his child-molestation case.
Michael Jackson's child molestation trial begins with prosecutors alleging he sexually abused a 13-year-old cancer survivor at Neverland ranch.

In Michael Jackson's child molestation trial, the prosecution called Martin Bashir as its first witness and showed his documentary Living With Michael Jackson, while Jackson's defense sought to have the documentary and Bashir's testimony struck from the record.
Jurors in Michael Jackson's child molestation trial viewed a 12-minute videotape of his Neverland ranch bedroom suite, including rooms filled with dolls and toys, on the fourth day of the trial.
Michael Jackson's defence attorney sought to undermine the credibility of his accuser's younger brother by presenting a Father's Day card in court during the singer's child molestation trial.

In Michael Jackson's child molestation trial, the defense played a home movie and DVD of the alleged victim's first visit to Neverland ranch while cross-examining the alleged victim's younger brother about inconsistencies in his testimony.
Michael Jackson arrived late to court in pyjama bottoms after the judge ordered his arrest for failing to appear, and his accuser testified that Jackson masturbated him twice.
In Michael Jackson's child molestation trial, his teenage accuser admitted under cross-examination that he had previously told a teacher Jackson never touched him.

Prosecutors in Michael Jackson's trial showed jurors sexually explicit magazines, DVDs, and videos seized from Neverland Ranch, though witnesses acknowledged no evidence Jackson showed them to his accuser.
Michael Jackson appeared in court wearing a smart black trousers, crisp white shirt, red tie, and wire-framed spectacles, a notable change from his earlier foppish courtroom attire.
A California judge ruled that evidence of prior child molestation allegations could be considered at Michael Jackson's trial, a serious setback for the pop star.

In Michael Jackson's child molestation trial, the jury heard testimony from Jason Francia, who alleged that Jackson sexually molested him on three occasions over 16 years ago and gave him money to keep silent.
A former maid testified at Michael Jackson's child molestation trial that she had seen him in bed with young children and showering with a young boy.
Michael Jackson's lawyer challenges a former Neverland maid's credibility during Jackson's child molestation trial, accusing her of previously threatening to give evidence against the singer.

In Michael Jackson's child molestation trial, the mother of a boy who reached a multimillion-dollar settlement with Jackson in the 1990s testified that Jackson was "sobbing and crying, shaking and trembling" when she initially said he could not share her son's bed, and that she later relented.
The grandmother of Michael Jackson's teenage accuser testified that her grandchildren had changed after returning from Jackson's Neverland ranch, in Jackson's child molestation trial.
Macaulay Culkin testified as a defence witness at Michael Jackson’s child molestation trial, denying that Jackson ever molested him and calling the charges “absolutely ridiculous.”
Michael Jackson was acquitted of child sex charges, leading to a surge in US radio airplay of his songs.
Promoter Harvey Goldsmith confirms that organizers would consider adding Michael Jackson to the Live 8 Philadelphia concert bill if approached by the singer.
Michael Jackson began planning a Las Vegas concert residency, which included proposals for a 50-foot Michael Jackson robot, but the plans were ultimately abandoned due to funding problems.
Michael Jackson faces new child molestation allegations in a civil lawsuit filed by a 20-year-old man who also claims Jackson forced him to have plastic surgery and stole his musical ideas.
The website Dotmusic reports that Irish boyband Westlife may record a duet with Michael Jackson.
A new West End musical featuring Michael Jackson's greatest hits, titled Thriller: The Musical, is announced to premiere at the Dominion Theatre this summer.
Michael Jackson signed an exclusive recording agreement with Bahrain-based Two Seas Records and returned to the studio, with plans to release a new album next year.
Michael Jackson attended the World Music Awards in London, did not perform as announced, accepted a Diamond award, and sang a few lines of "We Are The World" before his voice faded out.
Michael Jackson is scheduled to attend a Premium VIP party in Japan where fans pay up to $3,500 to shake his hand and have their photo taken.

Michael Jackson has been in discussions with tourism officials and hotel owners about a Las Vegas residency, with proposed promotional plans including a 50-foot robot, though hotel owners are not yet convinced.
Michael Jackson is considering legal action to block an auction of Jackson family memorabilia, including his gold disc for Thriller, scheduled for May 30 and 31 in Las Vegas.

An auction of over 1,100 lots of Jackson family memorabilia, including Michael Jackson's costumes and Neverland purchase contract, is expected to be held at the Hard Rock hotel in Las Vegas after Michael Jackson's lawyers dropped an effort to block it.
Michael Jackson released a short video message marking the 25th anniversary of his album Thriller.

Michael Jackson may have to sell Neverland as the California ranch faces foreclosure, with a notice claiming he owes $24,525,906.61 to be paid in full before March 19 or the property will be auctioned off.
Michael Jackson returned to the studio in Las Vegas to work on a new album, banning women and his children from the studio to avoid distractions.
Michael Jackson narrowly escaped a foreclosure auction for his Neverland ranch after an investment firm, Colony Capital, bought the loan.
Michael Jackson denies plans to record or tour with his siblings, contradicting Jermaine Jackson's claim of a Jackson 5 reunion.
Michael Jackson is reportedly on the verge of signing a deal for a residency of shows at London's O2 Arena, though the deal is not confirmed.
Michael Jackson's Thriller video is rumored to be adapted into a Broadway musical, with no confirmation of Jackson's involvement.
Michael Jackson is expected to appear in person in the high court the following week to defend a $7m claim by Sheikh Abdullah of Bahrain over an alleged failed business venture.
An auction of Michael Jackson's personal memorabilia, including his white glove and the gates of Neverland ranch, is announced for April in Beverly Hills.
Michael Jackson announced an initial 10-date residency at the O2 arena, which was later extended to 50 concerts.
A Michael Jackson tribute show, Thriller Live, co-produced by Adrian Grant, opens in the West End.
John Landis sues Michael Jackson for failing to hand over his share of profits from the Thriller video.
John Landis sues Michael Jackson for failing to pay his share of profits from the Thriller video.
The contents of Michael Jackson's Neverland ranch are to be put up for auction in April, with proxy bidding opening today.
Michael Jackson auction: 'An era that will never be relived'
Michael Jackson is set to confirm a string of live dates at London's O2 Arena during a special announcement.
Michael Jackson announced additional London O2 arena dates, extending his farewell tour to 45 shows into January and February 2010.
Tickets for Michael Jackson's 50 live dates at London's O2 arena sold out, with one million tickets bought in a matter of hours.
Michael Jackson announces that his concerts at the O2 Arena in London in summer 2009 will be the last he ever plays there.
Michael Jackson's promoters, AEG Live, are struggling to find insurance for his 50-date O2 residency, with insurers reluctant to cover the seven-month run.
An auction of more than 2,000 items from Michael Jackson’s private collection and Neverland ranch is scheduled to be held at the Beverly Hilton hotel in Los Angeles.
A huge auction of Michael Jackson memorabilia from his Neverland estate was cancelled, with auctioneers agreeing to return all items to the singer.

An American promoter, AllGood Entertainment Inc, threatens to sue Michael Jackson for breach of contract, alleging he is barred from performing concerts before a Jackson family reunion gig in July 2010.
Michael Jackson has started rehearsing for his 50-night residency at London's O2 arena, his first concert run in more than 12 years.

Michael Jackson's representatives announced that several of his London O2 Arena comeback shows scheduled for July will be postponed, with the opening night moved from 8 July to 13 July and three other July shows rescheduled to March 2010.
AllGood Entertainment filed a $40 million lawsuit against Michael Jackson, claiming his O2 Arena residency violates a 2008 contract for a Jackson Five reunion concert.

Producers announce that 300,000 Swarovski crystals will be integrated into the sets and costumes of Michael Jackson's This Is It residency at the O2 Arena, and several hundred new tickets are released.

Michael Jackson's final concert rehearsal at the Staples Centre was recorded in multi-camera high-definition video and multi-track surround-sound audio, and promoters AEG Live are reportedly considering releasing it as a live album and DVD.
Michael Jackson's death prompted tributes and vigils at the Glastonbury festival, where fans gathered to honor the singer.
Michael Jackson died of a heart attack, causing a surge in sales of his existing albums and leaving an unreleased comeback album unfinished.
Michael Jackson's family says his mother Katherine has been named the sole legal guardian of his three children in his will, while a custody fight looms with his ex-wife Debbie Rowe.
Fans pay tribute to Michael Jackson.
Michael Jackson is remembered as the first black artist to become the number one global pop star of his age, with his music and showmanship capturing all races and nations.
Michael Jackson, the pop star whose career spanned from the Jackson 5 to years of controversy, died, prompting a retrospective of his troubled life.

Los Angeles police interview Michael Jackson's personal cardiologist, Dr. Conrad Murray, who is not considered a suspect, as a second independent autopsy is conducted at the Jackson family's request following the singer's death.
Michael Jackson's album Number Ones reached the top of the UK album chart following a surge in sales after his death.

Following Michael Jackson's death, conflicting reports emerge about whether his ex-wife Debbie Rowe will seek custody of their two eldest children, with Rowe's attorney saying she will seek to look after them while the Times reports she has indicated she will not mount a custody suit.
Michael Jackson's mother Katherine Jackson was granted temporary guardianship of his three children after filing for custody in Los Angeles Superior Court.
Michael Jackson's death is discussed, with Steven Spielberg's description of him as "a fawn in a burning forest" noted as an insightful characterization.
Fans flock to the Apollo theatre for a Michael Jackson tribute.
Michael Jackson's family is planning to put his body on display at Neverland on Friday for a public farewell.
Michael Jackson’s post-mortem events continue, including rehearsal footage, funeral plans, and a potential custody dispute involving Debbie Rowe.
Michael Jackson's family cancelled plans for a public or private viewing at Neverland ranch, stating that plans for a public memorial are underway and will be announced shortly.
Michael Jackson's will was filed in a Los Angeles court, leaving his entire estate to a family trust and naming Diana Ross as potential guardian of his children.
Composer David Michael Frank claimed Michael Jackson had approached him about a planned album of classical music, with two incomplete demos Jackson had written but not recorded.
A feature-length Michael Jackson film is being considered from archive footage to help clear the late singer's estimated $400m estate debt.
Nearly 9,000 people were selected by lottery to receive free tickets to the Michael Jackson memorial to be held on Tuesday in Los Angeles.
A retrospective article argues that Michael Jackson's album Dangerous, released amid the Jordan Chandler allegations, represents his artistic peak rather than a decline.
Los Angeles officials called for a review of city expenditures for Michael Jackson's memorial service, claiming taxpayers were "ripped off" by costs exceeding $1.4 million.
Following Michael Jackson's death, fans worldwide posted their own cover versions of his songs on YouTube.
Michael Jackson's funeral was planned for the morning at Forest Lawn cemetery in the Hollywood Hills, ahead of a public memorial service at the LA Staples Centre.
Michael Jackson's body was transported to the Staples Centre for a public memorial following a private family service.
Michael Jackson's family plans a memorial event for him at the Staples Centre in downtown Los Angeles.
A report indicates that no new Michael Jackson material may be released until 2012 due to a contract with Sony Music.
Promoters of Michael Jackson's aborted O2 residency are in talks to sell nearly 80 hours of rehearsal footage for a planned concert film, with Sony Pictures reportedly leading bids at $50 million.
The Los Angeles city attorney launched a civil and criminal investigation into expenditures for Michael Jackson's July 7 memorial at the Staples Center.
Ian Brown says his forthcoming solo album My Way was inspired by Michael Jackson, though it was conceived before Jackson’s death and mastered on the day Jackson died.
Daughtry knocked Michael Jackson's Number Ones album off the top of the US album charts, ending its run at No 1 since Jackson's death on 2009-06-25.
The insurance policy for Michael Jackson's cancelled O2 residency will not pay out if the late star is found to have taken illegal drugs.
A Michael Jackson film featuring rehearsal footage for his planned London O2 Arena residency is to be released on 28 October.
More than a million fans allegedly tried to log in to the website of an upcoming Michael Jackson tribute concert, crashing its servers before the lineup was announced.
A coroner's report revealed Michael Jackson had a lethal dose of the sedative Propofol in his body when he died, with reports that his death was ruled a homicide.

The lawyer for Michael Jackson's former doctor, Conrad Murray, rejects "police theory" concerning the singer's death, disputing reported statements and the timeline of Murray's actions on the morning Jackson died.

The first stills from the Kenny Ortega-directed Michael Jackson concert documentary This Is It, featuring footage from his final tour rehearsals, are released online ahead of its October 28 cinema release.
Michael Jackson's 51st birthday was celebrated with a party in New York hosted by director Spike Lee.
Michael Jackson is to be buried in a private ceremony at the Holly Terrace in the Great Mausoleum at Forest Lawn cemetery in Los Angeles.
Michael Jackson was laid to rest in a private funeral service at Forest Lawn cemetery in Los Angeles.
Promotional material for the Michael Jackson documentary This Is It was released, showing rehearsal images and announcing a limited two-week release beginning 2009-10-28.
Two versions of a new Michael Jackson song and an unreleased spoken word track will appear on the soundtrack to This Is It, the documentary about the singer's last days.
Michael Jackson's first posthumous single, "This Is It," was released to radio stations and began streaming online.
Michael Jackson fans launched a campaign and planned protests at global premieres of the documentary This Is It, claiming it airbrushes the singer's declining health in his final days.
Sony Pictures extends the theatrical run of "This Is It," the documentary about Michael Jackson's final rehearsals, beyond its initial two-week showing after strong worldwide ticket sales.

A Los Angeles judge ruled that Michael Jackson's father, Joe Jackson, lacks legal standing to challenge the executors of the singer's estate, clearing the way for John Branca and John McClain to be confirmed as executors.

Michael Jackson memorabilia, including the rhinestone-encrusted white glove he wore when he first Moonwalked in 1983, sold at auction at the Hard Rock Cafe in New York for $350,000, part of 70 items that raised $2 million.
Michael Jackson memorabilia fetches $2m.
The FBI releases part of its dossier on Michael Jackson, revealing its involvement in a 1995 child pornography investigation and assistance requests during his 2003 child molestation trial.
A 3D video segment from Michael Jackson's aborted O2 residency is set to air at the Grammy awards as part of a tribute to the singer.
Officials announced they will file a criminal case against Michael Jackson's former doctor, Conrad Murray, expected to be a charge of involuntary manslaughter in connection with Jackson's death.
The Michael Jackson estate denies any connection to a proposed Michael Jackson museum in Gary, Indiana, saying it was never consulted and is not involved.
Joe Jackson and Gary, Indiana mayor Rudy Clay announced a feasibility study for a Michael Jackson museum and entertainment complex in the singer's hometown.
A judge scheduled a preliminary hearing for Dr Conrad Murray, the doctor charged over Michael Jackson's death, to begin on 2011-01-04.
Hollywood studios are reportedly competing for the chance to produce a new film based on Michael Jackson's groundbreaking Thriller video and song, with Kenny Ortega in line to direct.
A posthumous Michael Jackson album of unreleased tracks is planned for release in November.
A new Michael Jackson album featuring previously unheard tracks is set for release on 14 December in the UK, the first with new material since his 2009 death.
Katherine Jackson reportedly claims that several songs on Michael Jackson's forthcoming posthumous album are fake, while Sony releases the first single "Breaking News" from the album.

Michael Jackson's estate publicly defends the authenticity of vocals on the posthumous track "Breaking News" and other "Cascio tracks" amid allegations from Jackson's family that the recordings are fake.
Will.I.Am criticizes the forthcoming posthumous Michael Jackson album "Michael" as "disrespectful," while Akon, 50 Cent, and Lenny Kravitz are announced as guest artists on the album.
Akon says he will not release unfinished Michael Jackson tracks they recorded together, saying he might burn them.
Producer Teddy Riley confirms more posthumous Michael Jackson albums are planned following the release of the compilation Michael.
A posthumous Michael Jackson album titled Michael is reviewed, featuring unfinished material completed by collaborators, amid controversy over the authenticity of some vocals.
A new Michael Jackson album titled Michael, featuring previously unheard tracks, is set for release.
Items from the house where Michael Jackson died, including the bed in which he died, are to be auctioned.
Bee Gees singer Barry Gibb unveils footage of him recording an unreleased 2002 track, All in Your Name, with Michael Jackson.

Katherine Jackson announces a Michael Jackson tribute concert will be held at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff on 8 October, prompting Jermaine and Randy Jackson to criticize the event as ill-timed due to Conrad Murray's criminal trial.

Organisers announce the initial lineup for October's Michael Jackson tribute concert in Cardiff, which will include performances by Christina Aguilera, Cee Lo Green, JLS, Leona Lewis, Craig David, Alien Ant Farm and 3T.

Global Live Events dropped Kiss from the Michael Jackson tribute concert after complaints over Gene Simmons's remarks, and the Jackson estate sent a letter expressing multiple concerns about the show.

Kiss were reportedly added to the lineup for October's Michael Jackson tribute concert in Cardiff, drawing outrage from Jackson's fans due to Gene Simmons's prior allegations that Jackson was a paedophile.

Members of Michael Jackson's family, including brother Tito and sister Rebbie, are to collaborate with producer David Gest on a touring tribute, "A Jackson named Michael: Remembering a legend," planned to begin next March.
The involuntary manslaughter trial of Michael Jackson's personal physician, Conrad Murray, begins with prosecutors telling the jury that Murray's acts and omissions directly led to Jackson's death.
Michael Jackson's family announced a two-day tribute concert in Tokyo, where several of his brothers will perform to benefit children affected by Japan's March earthquakes.
Michael Jackson's brothers Jackie, Tito, Marlon and Jermaine are to reunite for tribute concerts in Tokyo on 14-15 October 2011, with Japanese-American pop star AI filling in for the late singer.
Michael Jackson's estate is in early talks with Hollywood producers about making a biopic of the late singer's life, though no deal is yet in place.

Julien's Auctions is holding an auction of the contents of Michael Jackson's last residence, including a blackboard inscribed by his daughter Paris and an armoire with his handwritten note, though the bed in which he died was withheld at his family's request.
David Gest reportedly intends to donate unreleased Michael Jackson recordings based on Robert Burns's poetry to the Robert Burns Birthplace Museum.

Michael Jackson's previously unreleased song "Don't Be Messin' 'Round" was surprise-released as the B-side to "I Just Can't Stop Loving You" and will also appear on the forthcoming 25th-anniversary reissue of Bad.

Spike Lee is in the final stages of post-production on a documentary about Michael Jackson's 1987 album Bad, featuring unreleased songs and interviews, due later in 2012 to coincide with the album's 25th anniversary reissue.
Spike Lee's documentary film Bad 25, a warm and celebratory study of Michael Jackson's 1987 album Bad, is reviewed.
The 25-year anniversary re-release of Michael Jackson's album Bad includes an unreleased track, Song Groove (Abortion Papers), which has generated controversy.
Forbes' annual poll of the richest dead celebrities ranked Elizabeth Taylor first with $210m earned in the past 12 months, overtaking Michael Jackson, whose estate took in $145m.

Jury selection began in a $40bn wrongful death lawsuit brought by Michael Jackson's mother, Katherine, against concert promoter AEG Live, which claims the company was negligent in hiring Conrad Murray to care for her son.
A new version of Michael Jackson's song "Slave to the Rhythm" featuring Justin Bieber was leaked to radio.
Epic Records announces the posthumous Michael Jackson album Xscape, with Timbaland as lead producer.
The second posthumous Michael Jackson album, Xscape, is reviewed, featuring eight unfinished demos reworked by producers including Timbaland.
A new posthumous Michael Jackson album, Xscape, featuring eight unreleased recordings, is scheduled for worldwide release by Epic Records.
A hologram of Michael Jackson is reportedly set to perform at the Billboard music awards.
Five years after Michael Jackson's death, his legacy and influence on global culture, fame, dance, celebrity privacy, and music are examined.
Michael Jackson's Neverland Ranch is expected to be put up for sale by Colony Capital for between $75m and $85m.
David Bowie surpassed Michael Jackson's ARIA chart record for most albums in the top 100 by a single artist, with 17 albums, while equalling Jackson's record of 13 albums in the top 50.
Spike Lee's documentary "Michael Jackson's Journey from Motown to Off the Wall," exploring Jackson's evolution from child star to solo artist, is reviewed ahead of its Showtime broadcast.
White British actor Joseph Fiennes was cast to play Michael Jackson in the Sky Arts comedy "Elizabeth, Michael and Marlon," which was shot in 2015 and is in post-production.
Thriller Live, a cheerful tribute to Michael Jackson, opened its 3,000th performance at the Lyric theatre in London.
A London law firm sues Michael Jackson's estate executors for breach of contract, claiming it is owed over $200,000 in unpaid fees for work done from 2007 to 2009.
The 30th anniversary of Michael Jackson's album Bad, released in 1987, is marked.
A posthumous Michael Jackson compilation album, Scream, is due to go on sale, featuring one new track made from a mash-up of five previously released songs.
Rumors continue that Michael Jackson will take up a residency at the O2 this year.
Michael Jackson's death anniversary is observed.
Michael Jackson received 12 Grammy nominations in 1983 after Thriller, mentioned as a past record in an article about Kanye West's 2004 nominations.
